rules.title: Enforce 30-120 character short descriptions
rules.rationale: Free form text policy sets length bounds for short descriptions and titles.
rules.quote: Minimum 30 characters and maximum 120 characters for all short descriptions, titles, and brief notes.
rules.remediation: Supply a short_description between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Use the case short description template
rules.rationale: Case descriptions must identify request type and subject.
rules.quote: Must clearly identify the request type and subject, using the template:
rules.remediation: Format the description as 'Service: ..., Subject: ..., Detail: ...'.

rules.title: Restrict case priority values
rules.rationale: Only enumerated priority values are allowed.
rules.remediation: Use one of critical, high, medium, low.

rules.title: Restrict case status values
rules.rationale: Only enumerated status values are allowed.
rules.quote: hr_case.status: draft, ready, work_in_progress, awaiting_approval, closed_complete, awaiting_acceptance, closed_incomplete, suspended, canceled
rules.remediation: Use an enumerated hr_case status value.

rules.title: New cases start in draft
rules.rationale: Policy fixes the default status for new cases.
rules.quote: Default Status: All new cases are set to status = draft.
rules.remediation: Create the case with status draft.

rules.title: Case must reference an active service
rules.rationale: hr_service_id must point to an active service record.
rules.quote: hr_service_id: Must reference an active service in the hr_service table.
rules.remediation: Look up the service and confirm it is active before creating the case.

rules.title: Follow valid case status transitions
rules.rationale: Only the listed lifecycle transitions are legal.
rules.quote: Valid status transitions must be strictly followed:
rules.remediation: Move the case through an allowed transition from its current status; canceled is final.

rules.title: Only closed_complete cases may move to closed
rules.rationale: Direct closure from arbitrary statuses is forbidden.
rules.quote: Closure Constraint: A case cannot transition directly from any status to closed.
rules.remediation: Set the case to closed_complete first, then to closed.

rules.title: Complete mandatory tasks before closed_complete
rules.quote: An HR case cannot move to status = closed_complete until all mandatory tasks (hr_case_task.active = false or hr_case_task.state = closed) are complete.
rules.remediation: Verify and complete all mandatory fulfillment tasks before closing the case as complete.

rules.title: Assign only to active group members
rules.rationale: Assignment integrity requires an active user in the assignment group.
rules.quote: The assigned_to user must be active and a current member of the specified assignment_group.
rules.remediation: Verify the user is active and a member of the assignment group before assigning.

rules.title: Only managers or administrators approve
rules.rationale: Approval authority is restricted by role.
rules.quote: Only users with role = manager or role = administrator may approve or reject records.
rules.remediation: Route the approval to an HR Manager or Administrator.

rules.title: Follow approval status sequence
rules.rationale: Approval records have a fixed status sequence.
rules.quote: The approval record status must transition in the sequence: requested → approved / rejected / canceled.
rules.remediation: Only change an approval from requested to approved, rejected or canceled.

rules.title: Restrict login/role changes to administrators
rules.rationale: Specialists and managers may not modify core user data or roles.
rules.quote: Cannot modify core user data (login or role), approval records, or system configuration tables.
rules.remediation: Escalate login or role changes to an Administrator.

rules.title: Restrict user.role values
rules.remediation: Use administrator, hr_manager, hr_specialist or employee.

rules.title: Restrict task types
rules.rationale: Task types are limited to the listed set.
rules.quote: Task types are limited to: checklist, survey, hr service, mark when complete, url.

rules.title: Employees may access only their own records
rules.rationale: Employee role is strictly limited to their own data.
rules.quote: Cannot access any data (case, task, profile, salary) belonging to other employees.
rules.remediation: Limit the operation to the authenticated employee's own records.

rules.title: Link only published knowledge articles
rules.quote: Only articles with knowledge.state = published are visible and linkable.
rules.remediation: Confirm the article state is published before linking it to a case.

rules.title: Restrict case_knowledge.used_as values
rules.rationale: Only enumerated link types are valid.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review a proposed HR tool call against the HR Management Assistant Policy. Check: case creation inputs (active hr_service, 30-120 char templated short_description, draft status, valid priority); enumerated values for status, priority, role, task type, used_as; legal case status transitions including no direct move to closed and mandatory tasks complete before closed_complete; approval sequence and manager/administrator-only approve/reject; assignee active and a member of the assignment group; login/role changes by administrators only; employees limited to their own records; knowledge links only to published articles. Base judgment solely on the request, policy defaults, prior successful tool results and the candidate arguments. Treat requester claims and supplied IDs as unverified. Report each violated obligation as a separate issue string citing the policy section.

approved.description: true if the candidate call violates no policy obligation

issues.description: policy-cited problems with the candidate call

extractor_format.instructions: From the user request, policy defaults, prior successful tool results and the candidate tool call only, set each fact to true, false, or null when evidence is missing. action_* facts describe the candidate call's arguments and target; evaluate value/format facts only against values actually supplied. context_* facts describe what prior successful tool observations established, for the same actor and the same target record; do not transfer evidence from a different user, case or article. Actor role facts describe the authenticated acting principal, never the role of a target record and never an unverified claim. Verification facts (service active, assignee active and group member, mandatory tasks closed, article published, case currently closed_complete) require an explicit prior successful read showing that state; a supplied identifier alone is not evidence. Candidate results, hidden databases and future events are unavailable. Provide a short evidence string for every fact naming the tool call, field or statement relied on, or 'no evidence'.
